classification_scheme.description: which classification vocabulary the description/symbol follows (e.g. AS 1726:2017, BS 5930:2015+A1:2020, ASTM D2487-17(2025))

content.description: the prose answer a content search can match

formation_name.description: the named surface geology unit under the site

horizontal_datum.description: the datum the source coordinate is in (GDA2020 today)

lithology.description: prose lithology description of the unit

map_scale.description: nominal scale of the product the answer came from; `null` where the product is a compilation with no single scale

map_source.description: which map service actually answered (1:100k state service vs 1:1M national fallback)

map_symbol.description: the map sheet's unit symbol/code for the unit

project.description: the project whose site coordinate was resolved

projection_zone.description: the grid projection and zone, where the source states one

resolver_version.description: which resolver contract produced the answer

source_format.description: the exchange format/version the answer came from (AGS 4.2, DIGGS 2.6, DIGGS 3.0, vendor/map service)

vertical_datum.description: the vertical reference the source depths/heights are relative to (AHD in Australia)
